nodes.description:
Publish a new post to a publication. Requires authentication. Requires the
publication to be on the Pro plan.
nodes.name: mutation.publishPost

nodes.description:
Update an existing post. Requires authentication. Requires the publication
to be on the Pro plan.
nodes.name: mutation.updatePost

nodes.description:
Removes a post from your publication (soft delete). It disappears from
feeds and listings and its slug becomes available for reuse. Only the
post's author or a publication admin can remove it. Requires an active
Pro plan and authentication.
nodes.name: mutation.removePost

nodes.description:
Create a new draft on a publication without publishing it. Requires
authentication. Requires the publication to be on the Pro plan.
nodes.name: mutation.createDraft

nodes.description:
Update an existing draft. Requires authentication. Requires the publication
to be on the Pro plan.
nodes.name: mutation.updateDraft

nodes.description:
Publish an existing draft as a post. The draft is soft-deleted once the post
is created. Requires authentication. Requires the publication to be on the
Pro plan.
nodes.name: mutation.publishDraft

nodes.description:
Submit a draft on a team publication for editor review. Requires
authentication. Requires the publication to be on the Pro plan.
nodes.name: mutation.submitDraftForReview

nodes.description:
Reject a draft that was previously submitted for review. Only publication
owners and admins can reject. Requires authentication. Requires the
publication to be on the Pro plan.
nodes.name: mutation.rejectDraftSubmission

nodes.description:
Delete a draft. The draft's author can delete their own draft; publication
owners and admins can delete any draft in the publication. Requires
authentication. Requires the publication to be on the Pro plan.
nodes.name: mutation.deleteDraft

nodes.description:
Returns a presigned URL for uploading an image to Hashnode's CDN. Requires
authentication and a Pro plan.
nodes.name: mutation.createImageUploadURL

nodes.description:
Verifies a PUT-uploaded image (from presignedPut) is within the size limit,
deleting it if not. Call this after a successful PUT to presignedPut.url.
Requires authentication.
nodes.name: mutation.confirmImageUpload

specification.text:
scalar DateTime

scalar ObjectId

"""Arbitrary JSON object"""
scalar JSONObject

type Query {
  """Returns the current authenticated user. Requires authentication."""
  me: MyUser

  """
  Returns a post by ID. Requires the post's publication to be on the Pro plan.
  """
  post(id: ID!): Post

  """
  Returns a publication by ID or host. Requires the publication to be on the
  Pro plan.
  """
  publication(id: ObjectId, host: String): Publication

  """Returns a user by username"""
  user(username: String!): User

  """Returns a tag by slug"""
  tag(slug: String!): Tag

  """Returns a paginated feed of posts"""
  feed(first: Int!, after: String, filter: FeedFilter): FeedPostConnection!

  """
  Returns a draft by ID. Requires authentication and the draft's publication
  to be on the Pro plan.
  """
  draft(id: ObjectId!): Draft

  """
  Returns a scheduled post. Requires authentication and the publication to be
  on the Pro plan.
  """
  scheduledPost(id: ObjectId!): ScheduledPost

  """Check if a custom domain is available"""
  checkCustomDomainAvailability(input: CheckCustomDomainAvailabilityInput!): CheckCustomDomainAvailabilityResult!

  """Check if a subdomain is available"""
  checkSubdomainAvailability(subdomain: String!): CheckSubdomainAvailabilityResult!

  """
  Search posts within a publication. Needs at least one filter, such as a
  search query. Requires the publication to be on the Pro plan.
  """
  searchPostsOfPublication(first: Int!, after: String, sortBy: PostSortBy, filter: SearchPostsOfPublicationFilter!): SearchPostConnection!

  """
  Returns the users who comment most on a publication's posts. Requires the
  publication to be on the Pro plan.
  """
  topCommenters(publicationId: ObjectId!, limit: Int): [User!]!

  """Get documentation project by ID or host"""
  documentationProject(id: ID, host: String): DocumentationProject
}

type User {
  """The ID of the user. It can be used to identify the user."""
  id: ID!

  """
  The username of the user. It is unique and tied with user's profile URL.
  Example - https://hashnode.com/@username
  """
  username: String!

  """The name of the user."""
  name: String!

  """
  The bio of the user. Visible in about me section of the user's profile.
  """
  bio: Content

  """The URL to the profile picture of the user."""
  profilePicture: String
  coverImage: String

  """The tagline of the user. Shown on the user's profile below the name."""
  tagline: String

  """The location of the user."""
  location: String

  """
  The availability of the user based on tech stack and interests. Shown on the
  "I am available for" section in user's profile.
  """
  availableFor: String

  """Whether or not the user is deactivated."""
  deactivated: Boolean

  """The date the user joined Hashnode."""
  dateJoined: DateTime

  """
  The number of users that follow the requested user. Visible in the user's
  profile.
  """
  followersCount: Int!

  """
  The number of users that this user is following. Visible in the user's
  profile.
  """
  followingsCount: Int!
  posts(first: Int!, after: String): PostConnection!

  """Publications owned by the user."""
  publications(first: Int!, after: String): PublicationConnection!

  """The users who are following this user"""
  followers(first: Int!, after: String): UserConnection!

  """The users which this user is following"""
  follows(first: Int!, after: String): UserConnection!

  """The social media links of the user. Shown on the user's profile."""
  socialMediaLinks: SocialMediaLinks

  """Returns a list of badges that the user has earned."""
  badges: [Badge!]!
}

type MyUser {
  """The ID of the user. It can be used to identify the user."""
  id: ID!

  """
  The username of the user. It is unique and tied with user's profile URL.
  Example - https://hashnode.com/@username
  """
  username: String!

  """The name of the user."""
  name: String!

  """Email address of the user."""
  email: String!

  """
  The bio of the user. Visible in about me section of the user's profile.
  """
  bio: Content

  """The URL to the profile picture of the user."""
  profilePicture: String
  coverImage: String

  """The tagline of the user. Shown on the user's profile below the name."""
  tagline: String

  """The location of the user."""
  location: String

  """
  The availability of the user based on tech stack and interests. Shown on the
  "I am available for" section in user's profile.
  """
  availableFor: String

  """The date the user joined Hashnode."""
  dateJoined: DateTime

  """Publications owned by the user."""
  publications(first: Int!, after: String): PublicationConnection!

  """The users who are following this user"""
  followers(first: Int!, after: String): UserConnection!

  """The users which this user is following"""
  follows(first: Int!, after: String): UserConnection!

  """The social media links of the user. Shown on the user's profile."""
  socialMediaLinks: SocialMediaLinks

  """
  Returns a list of badges that the user has earned. Shown on blogs /badges
  page.
  """
  badges: [Badge!]!
}

type SocialMediaLinks {
  """The user's Twitter profile."""
  twitter: String

  """The user's GitHub profile."""
  github: String

  """The user's LinkedIn profile."""
  linkedin: String

  """The user's website."""
  website: String

  """The user's Facebook profile."""
  facebook: String

  """The user's Instagram profile."""
  instagram: String

  """The user's StackOverflow profile."""
  stackoverflow: String

  """The user's YouTube profile."""
  youtube: String
}

type Badge {
  """The ID of the badge."""
  id: ID!

  """The name of the badge."""
  name: String!

  """The description of the badge."""
  description: String

  """The image of the badge."""
  image: String!
}

type PublicationFeatures {
  """Flag to denote if publication is a pro team's publication."""
  proTeam: ProTeamFeature

  """
  Newsletter feature for the publication which adds a /newsletter route for
  collecting subscribers and allows sending out newsletters.
  """
  newsletter: NewsletterFeature

  """Show the view count for blog posts."""
  viewCount: ViewCountFeature

  """Show the read time for blog posts."""
  readTime: ReadTimeFeature

  """
  Widget that shows up if a text on a blog post is selected. Allows for easy
  sharing or copying of the selected text.
  """
  textSelectionSharer: TextSelectionSharerFeature

  """GPT Bot crawler to index the publication."""
  gptBotCrawling: GPTBotCrawlingFeature

  """Headless CMS for the publication."""
  headlessCMS: HeadlessCMSFeature
}

type ProTeamFeature {
  """A flag indicating if the Pro team feature is enabled or not."""
  isEnabled: Boolean!
}

type NewsletterFeature {
  """A flag indicating if the newsletter feature is enabled or not."""
  isEnabled: Boolean!
}

type ViewCountFeature {
  """A flag indicating if the view count feature is enabled or not."""
  isEnabled: Boolean!
}

type ReadTimeFeature {
  """A flag indicating if the read time feature is enabled or not."""
  isEnabled: Boolean!
}

type TextSelectionSharerFeature {
  """
  A flag indicating if the text selection sharer feature is enabled or not.
  """
  isEnabled: Boolean!
}

type GPTBotCrawlingFeature {
  """A flag indicating if the GPT Bot Crawler feature is enabled or not."""
  isEnabled: Boolean!
}

type PublicationAeoSettings {
  isEnabled: Boolean!
  llmsTxtEnabled: Boolean!
  crawlers: AeoCrawlerSettings!
}

type AeoCrawlerSettings {
  gptBot: Boolean!
  claudeBot: Boolean!
  perplexityBot: Boolean!
  googleExtended: Boolean!
  ccBot: Boolean!
}

type HeadlessCMSFeature {
  """A flag indicating if the Headless CMS feature is enabled or not."""
  isEnabled: Boolean!
}

type DomainInfo {
  """
  The subdomain of the publication on hashnode.dev. It will redirect to you
  custom domain if it is present and ready.
  """
  hashnodeSubdomain: String
  domain: Domain
  wwwPrefixedDomain: Domain
}

type Domain {
  host: String!
  ready: Boolean!
}

type RedirectionRule {
  """The source URL of the redirection rule."""
  source: String!
  destination: String!
  type: Int!
}

type CustomRule {
  type: Int!
  path: String!
  destination: String!
}

type ImprintV2 {
  html: String
}

type PublicMembers {
  totalDocuments: Int!
}

type Publication {
  """The ID of the publication."""
  id: ID!

  """
  The title of the publication. Title is used as logo if logo is not provided.
  """
  title: String!

  """The title of the publication. Shown in blog home page."""
  displayTitle: String

  """
  The domain of the publication. Used to access publication. Example
  https://johndoe.com
  """
  url: String

  """The canonical URL of the publication."""
  canonicalURL: String

  """The favicon of the publication. Used in browser tab."""
  favicon: String

  """The about section of the publication."""
  about: Content

  """The SEO description of the publication. Use seo.description instead."""
  descriptionSEO: String @deprecated(reason: "Use seo.description")

  """
  SEO settings of the publication. Returns only explicitly set values,
  with no fallback to the publication name or about text.
  """
  seo: SEO

  """The author who owns the publication."""
  author: User!

  """Returns the post with the given slug."""
  post(slug: String!): Post
  redirectedPost(slug: String!): RedirectedPost

  """
  Returns the posts in the publication, newest first. Page size is capped at
  100.
  """
  posts(first: Int!, after: String, filter: PublicationPostConnectionFilter): PostConnection!

  """
  Total number of published posts in the publication. Select totalDocuments,
  and use first: 1.
  """
  postsCount(first: Int!): PostConnection!

  """Returns series by slug in the publication."""
  series(slug: String!): Series

  """Returns the list of series in the publication."""
  seriesList(first: Int!, after: String): SeriesConnection!

  """Returns the static page with the given slug."""
  staticPage(slug: String!): StaticPage

  """Returns a list of static pages in the publication."""
  staticPages(first: Int!, after: String): StaticPageConnection!
  """
  Members of the publication. Members who set their visibility to private are excluded.
  """
  members(first: Int!, after: String): PublicationMemberConnection!
  """
  Count of publicly visible members. Members who set their visibility to private are excluded.
  """
  publicMembers(page: Int!, pageSize: Int!): PublicMembers!

  """
  Returns true if GitHub backup is configured and active and false otherwise.
  """
  isGitHubBackupEnabled: Boolean!

  """Returns whether the publication's GitHub source repo is connected."""
  isGithubAsSourceConnected: Boolean!

  """
  Details of publication invites. Returns null if publication is not a team publication.
  """
  invites: PublicationInvite

  """
  Returns the drafts of the authenticated user in the publication. Page size
  is capped at 50.
  """
  drafts(first: Int!, after: String): DraftConnection!

  """
  Returns the drafts of every author in the publication. Only the publication
  owner and admins can read it. Page size is capped at 50.
  """
  allDrafts(first: Int!, after: String): DraftConnection!

  """
  Returns the scheduled drafts of the authenticated user in the publication.
  Page size is capped at 50.
  """
  scheduledDrafts(first: Int!, after: String): DraftConnection!

  """
  Returns the drafts submitted for review in the publication. Only the
  publication owner and admins can read it. Page size is capped at 50.
  """
  submittedDrafts(first: Int!, after: String): DraftConnection!

  """
  Returns the scheduled drafts of every author in the publication. Only the
  publication owner and admins can read it. Page size is capped at 50.
  """
  allScheduledDrafts(first: Int!, after: String): DraftConnection!
  preferences: PublicationPreferences!

  """The integrations connected to the publication."""
  integrations: PublicationIntegrations

  """Links to the publication's social media profiles."""
  links: PublicationLinks

  """True if the publication is a team publication and false otherwise."""
  isTeam: Boolean!

  """Total number of followers of the publication."""
  followersCount: Int

  """Returns the pinned post of the publication."""
  pinnedPost: Post

  """Whether the publication has earned any badges or not."""
  hasBadges: Boolean
  urlPattern: String

  """The meta tags associated with the publication."""
  metaTags: String

  """Information about the publication's Open Graph metadata i.e. image."""
  ogMetaData: OpenGraphMetaData

  """
  Object containing information about beta features enabled for the
  publication.
  """
  features: PublicationFeatures!
  aeoSettings: PublicationAeoSettings!

  """Domain information of the publication."""
  domainInfo: DomainInfo!

  """
  A flag to indicate if the publication is using Headless CMS. This can be
  used to check if the post redirect needs authentication.
  """
  isHeadless: Boolean!

  """
  Color code of the header color of the publication. Used to style header of
  blog.
  """
  headerColor: String

  """Configured redirection rules for the publication."""
  redirectionRules: [RedirectionRule!]!
  customRules: [CustomRule!]!
  imprintV2: ImprintV2

  """The total amount of recommended publications by this publication."""
  totalRecommendedPublications: Int!
  recommendedPublications: [RecommendedPublicationEdge!]!

  """
  Boolean flag indicating if the publication allows edits by contributors
  """
  allowContributorEdits: Boolean!

  """
  Active custom widgets for this publication. Pinned widgets render on
  every article; others are embedded inline via %%[widgetId] tokens.
  """
  widgets: [Widget!]!
}

"""
A custom HTML widget an author can pin to all articles or embed inline. For example, newsletter signup forms, or a "Buy me a coffee" button.
"""
type Widget {
  """The unique identifier of the widget"""
  id: ID!

  """The author-defined slug used in %%[widgetId] embed tokens."""
  widgetId: String!

  """Content of the widget, can be a simple string or HTML"""
  content: String!
  isPinned: Boolean!
  pinLocation: WidgetPinLocation
}

enum WidgetPinLocation {
  top
  bottom
}

type RecommendedPublicationEdge {
  """The node holding the Publication information"""
  node: Publication!
}

type RedirectedPost {
  id: ID!
  slug: String!
}

type PublicationPreferences {
  logo: String
  darkMode: DarkModePreferences
  navbarItems: [PublicationNavbarItem!]!
  enabledPages: EnabledPages!
  layout: String
  disableFooterBranding: Boolean
  isSubscriptionModalDisabled: Boolean
}

type DarkModePreferences {
  """A flag indicating if the dark mode is enabled for the publication."""
  enabled: Boolean!

  """The custom dark mode logo of the publication."""
  logo: String
}

type PublicationNavbarItem {
  """The unique identifier of the navbar item."""
  id: ID!
  type: String!

  """The label of the navbar item."""
  label: String!

  """The URL of the navbar item."""
  url: String

  """The series added to the navbar item."""
  series: Series

  """The static page added to the navbar item."""
  page: StaticPage
}

type EnabledPages {
  badges: Boolean!
  newsletter: Boolean!
  members: Boolean!
}

type PublicationIntegrations {
  """Google Analytics Tracking ID for integration with Google Analytics."""
  gaTrackingID: String

  """FB Pixel ID for integration with Facebook Pixel."""
  fbPixelID: String

  """Hotjar Site ID for integration with Hotjar."""
  hotjarSiteID: String

  """Matomo URL for integration with Matomo Analytics."""
  matomoURL: String

  """Matomo Site ID for integration with Matomo Analytics."""
  matomoSiteID: String

  """Fathom Analytics Site ID for integration with Fathom Analytics."""
  fathomSiteID: String

  """
  A flag indicating if the custom domain is enabled for integration with
  Fathom Analytics.
  """
  fathomCustomDomainEnabled: Boolean

  """Custom domain for integration with Fathom Analytics."""
  fathomCustomDomain: String

  """
  A flag indicating if Plausible Analytics is enabled for the publication.
  """
  plausibleAnalyticsEnabled: Boolean

  """Google Tag Manager ID for integration with Google Tag Manager."""
  gTagManagerID: String

  """
  Web Monetization Payment Pointer for integration with Web Monetization.
  """
  wmPaymentPointer: String

  """Koala Public Key for integration with Koala."""
  koalaPublicKey: String

  """MS Clarity ID for integration with Microsoft Clarity."""
  msClarityID: String
  openPanelClientId: String
}

type PublicationLinks {
  """Twitter URL of the publication."""
  twitter: String

  """GitHub URL of the publication."""
  github: String

  """LinkedIn URL of the publication."""
  linkedin: String

  """Hashnode profile of author of the publication."""
  hashnode: String

  """Website URL of the publication."""
  website: String

  """Instagram URL of the publication."""
  instagram: String

  """YouTube URL of the publication."""
  youtube: String

  """Daily.dev URL of the publication."""
  dailydev: String

  """Mastodon URL of the publication."""
  mastodon: String

  """Facebook URL of the publication."""
  facebook: String

  """Bluesky URL of the publication."""
  bluesky: String
}

type PublicationMember {
  """The ID of the publication member."""
  id: ID!

  """The user who is a member of the publication."""
  user: User!
  role: String!
}

enum UserPublicationRole {
  """Contributors can join the publication and contribute an article."""
  CONTRIBUTOR

  """
  Editors can customize the blog and approve/reject posts; they can also manage members.
  """
  EDITOR

  """The owner is the creator of the publication and can do all things."""
  OWNER
}

type OffsetPageInfo {
  """Indicates if there are more pages."""
  hasNextPage: Boolean

  """Indicates if there are previous pages."""
  hasPreviousPage: Boolean

  """The page after the current page."""
  nextPage: Int

  """The page before the current page."""
  previousPage: Int
}

"""Contains the publication invite information."""
type PublicationInvite {
  pendingInvites(pageSize: Int!, page: Int!): PendingInviteConnection!

  """The paginated list of role based invites."""
  roleBasedInvites(pageSize: Int!, page: Int!): RoleBasedInviteConnection!

  """Signifies if invite links in role-based invites are active."""
  areRoleBasedInviteLinksActive: Boolean!
}

type PendingInviteConnection {
  """A list of invites"""
  nodes: [PendingInvite!]!

  """Information to aid in pagination."""
  pageInfo: OffsetPageInfo!

  """The total number of invites."""
  totalDocuments: Int!
}

type RoleBasedInviteConnection {
  """A list of invites"""
  nodes: [RoleBasedInvite!]!

  """Information to aid in pagination."""
  pageInfo: OffsetPageInfo!

  """The total number of invites."""
  totalDocuments: Int!
}

"""Contains the pending invite information."""
type PendingInvite {
  """The ID of the pending invite."""
  id: ID!

  """The email of the user that was invited."""
  email: String

  """
  Invited Hashnode user, returns null if the user is not a Hashnode user.
  """
  user: User

  """The role assigned to the user in the publication."""
  role: UserPublicationRole!
}

type RoleBasedInvite {
  """The ID of the role based invite."""
  id: ID!

  """The role assigned to the user in the publication."""
  role: UserPublicationRole!

  """Boolean that signifies if the invite has unlimited capacity."""
  isUnlimitedCapacity: Boolean

  """
  The number of members that have already used the link to join the team.
  """
  usedCapacity: Int

  """The capacity of how many members to be invited by the link."""
  capacity: Int

  """Invite link of the role based invite."""
  inviteLink: String

  """The date the invite was created."""
  createdAt: DateTime

  """The expiry date of the invite."""
  expiryDate: DateTime
}

type Post {
  """The ID of the post. Used to uniquely identify the post."""
  id: ID!

  """A unique ID of the post."""
  cuid: String

  """The title of the post."""
  title: String!

  """
  The subtitle of the post. Subtitle is a short description of the post which
  is also used in SEO if meta tags are not provided.
  """
  subtitle: String

  """
  The slug of the post. Used as address of the post on blog. Example -
  https://johndoe.com/my-post-slug
  """
  slug: String!

  """
  Complete URL of the post including the domain name. Example -
  https://johndoe.com/my-post-slug
  """
  url: String!

  """
  Content of the post. Contains HTML and Markdown version of the post content.
  """
  content: Content!

  """
  Brief is a short plain-text description of the post, extracted from the
  start of its content.
  """
  brief: String!

  """
  The cover image preference of the post. Contains cover image URL and other
  details.
  """
  coverImage: CoverImage

  """Returns the user details of the author of the post."""
  author: User!

  """
  Returns the user details of the co-authors of the post. Hashnode users can
  add up to 4 co-authors as collaborators to their posts. This functionality
  is limited to teams publication.
  """
  coAuthors: [User!]

  """The publication the post belongs to."""
  publication: Publication

  """
  Returns list of tags added to the post. Contains tag id, name, slug, etc.
  """
  tags: [Tag!]

  """The number of hearts on the post. Shows how many users liked the post."""
  reactionCount: Int!

  """The number of comments on the post."""
  responseCount: Int!

  """The number of replies on the post."""
  replyCount: Int!

  """The estimated time to read the post in minutes."""
  readTimeInMinutes: Int!

  """
  The number of views on the post. Can be used to show the popularity of the
  post.
  """
  views: Int

  """Flag to indicate if the post is featured on Hashnode feed."""
  featured: Boolean

  """The date and time the post was published."""
  publishedAt: DateTime!

  """The date and time the post was last updated."""
  updatedAt: DateTime

  """Canonical URL set by author in case of republished posts."""
  canonicalUrl: String

  """
  A flag to indicate if the post contains LaTeX. Latex is used to write
  mathematical equations.
  """
  hasLatexInPost: Boolean

  """A list of comments on the post."""
  comments(first: Int!, after: String): CommentConnection!

  """A list of users who liked the post."""
  likedBy(first: Int!, after: String): UserConnection!

  """Information of the series the post belongs to."""
  series: Series

  """
  SEO information of the post. Contains title and description used in meta
  tags.
  """
  seo: SEO

  """
  OG meta-data of the post. Contains image url used in open graph meta tags.
  """
  ogMetaData: OpenGraphMetaData

  """Post feature-related fields."""
  features: PostFeatures!

  """
  Preference settings for the post. Contains information about if the post is
  pinned to blog, comments are disabled, etc.
  """
  preferences: PostPreferences!
  faq: [PostFaqItem!]!
}

type PostFaqItem {
  question: String!
  answer: String!
}

type Content {
  """The Markdown version of the content."""
  markdown: String!

  """The HTML version of the content."""
  html: String!

  """
  The text version from sanitized html content. HTML tags are stripped and
  only text is returned.
  """
  text: String!
}

type CoverImage {
  url: String
  attribution: String
  photographer: String
  isPortrait: Boolean
  isAttributionHidden: Boolean
}

type SEO {
  """The title used in og:title tag for SEO purposes."""
  title: String

  """The description used in og:description tag for SEO purposes."""
  description: String
}

type OpenGraphMetaData {
  """The image used in og:image tag for SEO purposes."""
  image: String
}

type PostFeatures {
  tableOfContents: TableOfContents

type Draft {

  id: ID!

  """
  The title of the draft. It would become the title of the post when
  published.

  title: String

  The subtitle of the draft. It would become the subtitle of the post when
  published.
  """

  """
  The slug of the draft. If it is empty, the slug is generated from the title
  when the draft is published.
  """
  slug: String

  """Content of the draft in HTML and markdown"""
  content: Content

  """The author of the draft."""
  author: User!

  """
  The cover image preference of the draft. Contains cover image URL and other
  details.
  """
  coverImage: CoverImage

  """
  Returns list of tags added to the draft. Contains tag id, name, slug, etc.

  """
  The user credited as the author of the post when the draft is published,
  instead of the draft's author.
  """
  publishAs: User
  settings: DraftSettings

  """The date and time the draft was last updated."""
  updatedAt: DateTime!

  """The date the draft is scheduled to be published."""
  scheduledDate: DateTime

  """The publication the draft belongs to."""
  publication: Publication

  """The series the draft will belong to once published."""
  series: Series

  """Co-authors of the draft. Set via createDraft/updateDraft input."""
  coAuthors: [User!]

  """
  Canonical URL for republished content, if the draft was imported from

  canonicalUrl: String

  """SEO metadata for the resulting post."""
  seo: SEO

  """Open Graph metadata for the resulting post."""
  ogMetaData: OpenGraphMetaData

  """Draft feature flags (e.g. table of contents preference)."""

type Mutation {
  """
  Publish a new post to a publication. Requires authentication. Requires the
  publication to be on the Pro plan.
  """
  publishPost(input: PublishPostInput!): PublishPostPayload!

  """
  Update an existing post. Requires authentication. Requires the publication
  to be on the Pro plan.
  """
  updatePost(input: UpdatePostInput!): UpdatePostPayload!

  """
  Removes a post from your publication (soft delete). It disappears from
  feeds and listings and its slug becomes available for reuse. Only the
  post's author or a publication admin can remove it. Requires an active
  Pro plan and authentication.
  """
  removePost(input: RemovePostInput!): RemovePostPayload!

  """
  Create a new draft on a publication without publishing it. Requires
  authentication. Requires the publication to be on the Pro plan.
  """
  createDraft(input: CreateDraftInput!): CreateDraftPayload!

  """
  Update an existing draft. Requires authentication. Requires the publication
  to be on the Pro plan.
  """
  updateDraft(input: UpdateDraftInput!): UpdateDraftPayload!

  """
  Publish an existing draft as a post. The draft is soft-deleted once the post
  is created. Requires authentication. Requires the publication to be on the
  Pro plan.
  """
  publishDraft(input: PublishDraftInput!): PublishDraftPayload!

  """
  Submit a draft on a team publication for editor review. Requires
  authentication. Requires the publication to be on the Pro plan.
  """
  submitDraftForReview(input: SubmitDraftForReviewInput!): SubmitDraftForReviewPayload!

  """
  Reject a draft that was previously submitted for review. Only publication
  owners and admins can reject. Requires authentication. Requires the
  publication to be on the Pro plan.
  """
  rejectDraftSubmission(input: RejectDraftSubmissionInput!): RejectDraftSubmissionPayload!

  """
  Delete a draft. The draft's author can delete their own draft; publication
  owners and admins can delete any draft in the publication. Requires
  authentication. Requires the publication to be on the Pro plan.
  """
  deleteDraft(input: DeleteDraftInput!): DeleteDraftPayload!

  """
  Returns a presigned URL for uploading an image to Hashnode's CDN. Requires
  authentication and a Pro plan.
  """
  createImageUploadURL(input: CreateImageUploadInput!): CreateImageUploadPayload!

  """
  Verifies a PUT-uploaded image (from presignedPut) is within the size limit,
  deleting it if not. Call this after a successful PUT to presignedPut.url.
  Requires authentication.
  """
  confirmImageUpload(input: ConfirmImageUploadInput!): ConfirmImageUploadPayload!
}
